hits.subject: Israel customs situation
hits.preview: Hello Dames, Aanschouw onderstaande (AI) woordenbrij Zouden jullie je kijk hierover kunnen geven. Ik denk wel dat we UTI / UMI dienen in te lichten zodat ze mogelijk bepaalde parts per air kunnen bestellen. Zou niet te veel paniek willen veroorzaken maar we moeten wel zeggen dat er nu toch wel al een vertraging is van enkele weken al. Zouden jullie die 2 rode zaken kunnen invullen en indien er correcties nodig zijn laat maar weten. Dear all, I wanted to flag something that's affecting our shipments right now. We've seen a real increase in customs checks on our end. These inspections can be both administrative and physical. The physical inspections can take up to a month to clear. Luckily we only had 1 so far. (Invoice nummer) We currently have 3 shipments stuck in this process. As a direct consequence, we haven't been able to start picking SOR orders since last week ((PO reference UTI 2614897 PO reference 2615054 ) That is why normal operations are on hold until the first shipment can leave which is now planned for Datum We are doing what we can to speed things up, but honestly, the timeline is in customs' hands, not ours. We will keep you posted as soon as there's movement. Thanks for understanding. Jérôme Van der Pluym Assistant Manager // Pricing analyst Sales – Vehicle Parts | Isuzu Motors Europe NV +32 475 851 089 jerome.van.der.pluym@isuzu-e.com <mailto:jerome.van.der.pluym@isuzu-e.com> Bist 12, 2630 Aartselaar, Belgium

Dear Mr. Amit Ron We deeply appreciate your ongoing dedication and steadfast efforts in addressing the diverse challenges and strategic initiatives we've encountered in Aftersales activities together. We are pleased to announce the Aftersales Awards 2026 in this e-mail and letter. ISUZU Aftersales Awards is a program that surveys and awards distributors and dealers for their aftersales activities. Through this program, both ISUZU and distributors/dealers will understand the actual condition of aftersales activities in each market and implement activities together to improve aftersales. By building this cycle as a permanent effort, we aim to raise the level of our aftersales activities and realize a brand that is chosen by customers for its reliability in supporting customers’ uptime worldwide. For details, please review the attachments and consider whether you participate in this program. hits.preview: Dear Gina, Allow me to explain why we work with this margin. As you know the Shell business is substantial for UMI (and VEH parts operations) Here is a summary of how determined this pricing: * ISZE did not change their margin for these products since a few years. * We took a different approach for this product as the handling in our warehouse is different. It basically arrives & leaves as a whole shipment resulting in basically no handling & storage costs. * No transport costs, no duties are in place as well. * We also have reserved a support amount for the lubricant business 20K€. (Promotional support) * We used to work with a credit note from the Shell in the past, but Shell has proposed to reduced purchase prices for ISZE instead. ISZE kept the CR to UMI as a safety measure to keep the required sales volume intact. (as you can see are margin increased to partially cover the credit note to UMI in combination with the promotional support amount) I hope this explains the CR amount, please let me know if you still have questions. AS UMI has now reached the target ISZE will reduce the sales price so no we don’t work with CR for the incoming shipments. Dear Yoshimoto-san, Please find below clarification on your questions: * Annual support Yes, the support is included in the current business plan and is provided on an annual basis. * Timing of the MOU Historically, the MOU is signed prior to the customer placing a scrap order. The rationale is that the actual need for support can vary depending on the distributor’s circumstances and order planning, therefore the MOU is concluded when the support is effectively required. * Order records / ceilings Each customer is eligible to place PRD orders up to a maximum value of €80,000. When the full €80,000 is ordered, a support amount of €20,000 is granted in the form of a credit note. With this MOU distributor get’s 25% of it’s initial PRD order. So if the distributor places an order of €40,000 customer receives a support amount of 10,000€ * Budget alignment The total support foreseen is fully within the approved business plan for the current fiscal year. hits.subject: Information oil
hits.preview: Dear Erez Please find the information attached. We completed all the criteria except for the two points listed below, as they are not relevant to the products in question : * METAL CONCENTRATION (PPM VALUE) : * For hydraulic oils ( Shell Tellus) there are no fixed ppm values for metal concentrations in the product specifications themselves, as these oils are supplied new with a high degree of purity. The metal concentration in ppm is mainly relevant during oil analysis in use, to detect wear or contamination. * For engine oils ( Shell Rimula) : Metal concentration in ppm is not mentioned in the datasheets of new oil, because this value only becomes relevant during oil analysis of used oil. * TBN : * Not listed in the technical datasheets for Shell Tellus S2 hydraulic oils. TBN is a measure of an oil’s ability to neutralize acids, and it's primarily relevant for engine oils where combustion byproducts cause acid buildup. Kind regards, Koen Matheussen Assistant Manager Sales – Vehicle Parts| Isuzu Motors Europe NV +32 471 613 772 Koen.matheussen@isuzu-e.com Bist 12, 2630 Aartselaar, Belgium

hits.subject: [SPI & KPI] Monthly Submission of SPI & KPI Check Sheet - August
hits.preview: Dear Esteemed Business Partners, As ISZE already announced, in our effort to streamline processes and reduce workload from this month on, we combined the SPI and KPI sheet. 2 Inventory Questions as 5 & 6 have been added. Also the sheet now covers all Months from January to December to reduce issues if reporting for one Month has been missed. We will take care of the internal splitting ourselves, so you will no longer receive two separate files from IMG & ISZE at the beginning of each month. Please make sure to send your file to sales@isuzu-e.com as well as to my Email. Attached we send you the new SPI & KPI Check Sheet. Please send us your document back until the 14th of September (See attached file: KPI & SPI Check Sheet Monthly.xlsx) We appreciate your continued cooperation and the consistent effort you make in providing us with the necessary data. Your support is critical to maintaining smooth operations and reliable reporting.
